_meta.method: Paired three-year Monte Carlo per department at ZERO incremental haulage, run twice: once with optical sorting access and once without, because the grading hazard model has a step at the access threshold. Distance is applied afterwards in closed form, since haulage enters the margin linearly in tonnes of food-grade harvest.
_meta.caveat: One soil archetype and one baseline rotation per department. A real parcel should always be run through the farmer endpoint, which uses its own soil, rotation and RPG history.
